releaseNotes: New: SOLVE OOS - analyze and repair actionable out-of-sequence logic in a Primavera P6 XER
Detects only current actionable OOS conditions (no historical rewrite); Case 2, non-zero lags, actionable SF and multi-project/cross-project inputs are detected and safely blocked
Case 4 unsatisfiable links are removed and bridged with verified upstream/downstream logic; loop checks run before and after every step
Writes a NEW XER under a cloned project identity - the source file is never modified - with a full phased report and a CREATE NEW PROJECT import warning
Also includes the beta.14 HTML Dashboard / P6-style WBS Gantt improvements
